# CLI

`vngcloud <service> <operation> [flags]` calls one SDK operation, listed below by service. `vngcloud configure` prompts for a profile's region and credentials, `vngcloud configure set|get|list` scripts the same, and `vngcloud version` prints the version.

## Services

- [Billing](CLI-Billing.md)
- [Compute](CLI-Compute.md)
- [DNS](CLI-DNS.md)
- [Network](CLI-Network.md)
- [Pricing](CLI-Pricing.md)

## Global flags

| Flag | Meaning |
|-|-|
| `--profile` | Profile to use |
| `--region` | Region to use |
| `--project-id` | Project ID to use |
| `--output` | `json`, `table`, or `text`; default from the profile's `output`, else `json` |
| `--query` | JMESPath expression to filter output |
| `--yes` | Confirm a destructive operation |
| `--debug` | Log requests to stderr |
| `--read-only` | Refuse every write command |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|-|-|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | API or network error, or a canceled command |
| 2 | Usage or config error: bad flags, a missing `--yes`, a read-only refusal, or a missing region |
| 3 | No credentials, or a login failure |
| 4 | Not found |

## Error classes

A failed command prints one JSON line to stderr:

```json
{"error":{"code":"NotFound","message":"server not found","status":404,"operation":"compute.GetServer"}}
```

`status` and `operation` appear only for an API error, whose `code` is the API's own code. Every other error names one class: `InvalidUsage`, `ReadOnly`, `InvalidConfig`, `NoCredentials`, `LoginFailed`, `RequestFailed`, or `QueryFailed`.

## Read-only

Read-only refuses every write command before any request. Any of these turns it on, and none can turn it off: `--read-only`; `VNGCLOUD_READ_ONLY` set to `1` or `true`; the profile's own `read_only` config key set to `true`.

## Rename table

A flag or operation name the mechanical kebab-case conversion would otherwise get wrong:

| Name | CLI form |
|-|-|
| `Query` | `search` |
| `VPCID` | `vpc-id` |
